title: Airbus Corporate Helicopters unveils new ACH Line interior for ACH130 fleet
summary: First showcased as a cabin concept for the ACH140 at Verticon, this updated layout made its official operational debut on the ACH130 fleet.
body_markdown:
Airbus Corporate Helicopters (ACH) has unveiled its new signature ACH Line interior design for the ACH130, combining advanced cabin ergonomics, operational versatility, and enhanced travel functionality for corporate and private operators worldwide.


First showcased as a cabin concept for the ACH140 at Verticon, this updated layout made its official operational debut on the ACH130 fleet, setting a new benchmark for style and functional harmony across the broader ACH range.


Airbus Corporate Helicopters Photo


To achieve the highest standards of precision and cabin outfitting, Airbus Helicopters in Italy led the engineering and certification and partnered with industry-leading interior specialists F/LIST and Maison Borghino.


“The new ACH Line look and feel will, for the first time, offer a visual consistency across our entire range, ensuring all ACH Line aircraft reflect the ACH brand and pedigree, while ensuring a standardized level of the highest quality and comfort across all ACH aircraft types,” said Nicolas Boltoukhine, head of ACH.


The cabin was unveiled during an exclusive event in Sappada, in the Italian Alps.


Airbus Corporate Helicopters Photo


Guests, including launch customer representative Maicol La Regina, CEO of Air Delta, admired the refined interior during demonstration flights to a unique and stunning backdrop in the Dolomites in northern Italy.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Airbus Corporate Helicopters.*
